findings: county_handlers.go:163-165 — ListFishers calls h.scoreSvc.GetScore(ctx, f.ID) once per fisher inside the page loop (per-row DB query), an N+1 the approved task explicitly requires absent ('no N+1' for county_handlers). The same handler already batch-fetches catch counts in a single IN (?) query (lines 141-160), so the score fetch is the only un-batched related query. Consequence: GET /county/fishers runs 1 + N queries per page (default page 20 → 21+ round trips); and because score.Service.GetScore falls through to Calculate on a missing cached score, each uncached fisher triggers ~5 extra queries plus an upsert WRITE to baharini_scores on a read path. pageSize is unbounded (no upper cap at lines 126-129), so a single request can fan out thousands of queries/writes. Correction: batch-fetch scores in one query — `SELECT user_id, score, tier FROM baharini_scores WHERE user_id IN (?)` over fisherIDs — build a userID->score map, and read from the map in the loop instead of calling GetScore per row (mirroring the existing catch-count batching).
